title: South Korea Names 26-Man World Cup Squad — Son Heung-min Leads; Jens Castrop Becomes First German-Korean in National Team
detail: Coach Hong Myung-bo officially unveiled South Korea's 26-man World Cup roster in Seoul on May 16. Son Heung-min captains the squad and leads the attack. Jens Castrop (Borussia Mönchengladbach), born to a German father and Korean mother, becomes the first dual-heritage German-Korean player ever named to the South Korean national team — a historic milestone. Kim Min-jae (Bayern Munich) and Lee Kang-in (PSG) are both included. Hwang In-beom was selected despite nursing an ankle injury since March. The squad also includes Kwon Chang-hoon, Oh Hyeon-gyu, and Lim Sang-hyeop among the attackers. Hong Myung-bo said the team's objective is to reach the round of 16 as a minimum. 26 days remain to the June 11 opening match at Estadio Azteca.

media.caption: South Korea coach Hong Myung-bo names 26-man World Cup squad — Son Heung-min captains; Jens Castrop becomes first German-Korean in Taeguk Warriors history

title: Scientists Warn of Extreme Heat Risk at Summer World Cup Venues; NJ/NY Transportation Still Contested 26 Days Out
detail: With 26 days remaining to kickoff, multiple storylines dominated May 16 coverage. Scientists and health officials raised formal concerns about extreme summer heat at North American outdoor venues — June and July temperatures in cities like Dallas (AT&T Stadium), Houston (NRG), and Kansas City (Arrowhead) regularly exceed 38°C, and no North American World Cup venue has previously hosted major international football in summer conditions at this scale. Fox 5 NY and other outlets reported that New York/New Jersey transportation disputes remained live following the earlier NJ Transit fare cut from $150 to $98 for MetLife Stadium — the Final venue. The Iran visa standoff also continued: as of May 16 no US visas had been issued to any Iranian player or coaching staff, with the FIFA-Taj Zurich meeting on May 20 now just four days away as the last formal diplomatic channel before the June 1 squad deadline.

media.caption: Heat safety concerns and Iran visa standoff dominate World Cup 2026 coverage as tournament approaches — 26 days to kickoff
